statement: For the full profinite modular group the linked and independently signed actual sources coincide; all numerical data are recovered from the automorphism. They preserve F and every Fermat kernel K_n and act on the actual relative pro-prime groups, continuous Q_l prounipotent completions, and integral abelian stages over Z_l. The retained signed normalizers and fibre products have explicitly typed strict and outer actions.

statement: The intersection of [K_n,K_n] over the entire Fermat tower is F-double-prime, and C/F-double-prime is its equivariant inverse limit. The complete relative pro-prime Fermat family detects precisely finite F-quotients with nilpotent derived subgroup, a proper pro-formation quotient. Action kernels on the abelian tower are given by two explicit generator congruences.

notes: Finite metabelian separation proves the first intersection; compactness proves inverse-limit surjectivity. Sylow quotients of a nilpotent derived group prove the second equality. statement: The exact actual signed-source image on Delta=C/F-prime is Zhat semidirect Zhat^times, with unique automorphisms Int(e0^r)s_mu and law (r,mu)(s,nu)=(r+mu*s,mu*nu). Its kernel is the based congruence subgroup acting trivially on the two modular generators modulo F-prime.

notes: Every multiplier is supplied by the actual cyclotomic Galois image. The standard braid correction vanishes on Delta, giving canonical s_mu. All elements and generator edges are checked in reductions n1 through8; these are not all isolated finite signed solutions.

statement: The whole profinite signed source has no action by Q-defined automorphisms of the first modular Lie stage compatible with its actual continuous Q5 action, and hence no compatible integral Z-model action. An actual Galois element with fifth-adic multiplier sqrt6 and other local multipliers1 gives the counterexample. The local and profinite actions in B31 are the correct replacement.
